profile.headline: Software Engineer at First American
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in a variety of industries. Skilled in Python, C++, Public Speaking, Ruby, and Java. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor's degree focused in Computer Science and Engineering from University of California, Merced.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Full stack .Net development (c#, html, javascript, SQL)
-Developed banking transactions front end from crypto trades.
-Implemented blockchain API's to work with the platform.

positions.title: IT Operations
positions.description:
-Improved workflow by creating SharePoint applications.
-Administrate infrastructure: firewalls, databases, malware and other processes.
-Built an internal technical documentation and manual for IT policies.

positions.title: IT Operations Intern
positions.description:
-Maintained all hardware and software for both server and users
-Increased team productivity by automating tasks using Powershell.
-Acted as escalation point for client services and consistently resolved issues to internal and external workers.
-Performed daily backups operations, ensuring all required systems and system data are successfully backed up
